aerial-a.defect: Water reflects only the sky colour; no object reflections exist.
aerial-a.fix: Add a planar/SSR reflection pass with wave-normal distortion for near water.

aerial-a.defect: Wake has no V-spread, no foam breakup and no fade with distance.
aerial-a.fix: Replace the line with a V-wake mesh using foam texture that widens and fades along the path.

aerial-a.defect: Tiling water and clone trees are both visible in ordinary play.
aerial-a.fix: Break the water tile period and instance trees with per-instance scale/rotation/hue.

aerial-a.defect: views.ts aerial-a places the plane 50 m from a fixed camera heading toward it, so every flight/clip frame lacks the aircraft.
aerial-a.fix: Use a chase camera or start the plane ~400 m out so it stays in frame for the 180 stepped frames.

aerial-a.defect: Draw-call budget exceeded by 26% in the still.
aerial-a.fix: Merge prop/tree instances per chunk and batch marina/boat draws.

aerial-a.defect: Glass is opaque from this angle; no cabin interior or reflection is visible.
aerial-a.fix: Use a transmissive glass material with a tinted interior and a fresnel-weighted environment reflection.

aerial-a.defect: Trees are uniform dark-green blobs of identical size and shade with no visible canopy structure or palms.
aerial-a.fix: Add 3-4 species with distinct silhouettes (palm, sea grape, ficus) and vary scale/hue per instance.

aerial-a.defect: Specular response is missing on both the water and the gloss paint.
aerial-a.fix: Enable specular highlights for the sun on the water BRDF and a clearcoat on the paint.

aerial-a.defect: Fixed camera loses the subject; aircraft climbs uncommanded with 70% throttle and no trim.
aerial-a.fix: Trim the aircraft to level flight at the bench throttle and use a follow camera for the aerial view.

aerial-a.defect: Trees are clone spheres without trunks or species variation.
aerial-a.fix: Instance 6-8 distinct tree meshes with trunk geometry and random scale/rotation.

aerial-a.defect: Sub-pixel cables break into dots and the causeway deck appears to lie on the water.
aerial-a.fix: Draw cables as screen-space lines with a minimum 1.5-px width and keep pier columns in the far LOD.

aerial-a.defect: Clone trees and clone building boxes are visible at once.
aerial-a.fix: Randomise tree meshes and building footprints.

bridge-low.defect: Paper-thin tail surfaces and a zero-width tail cone.
bridge-low.fix: Model closed tail surfaces with airfoil thickness and a rounded tail cone.

bridge-low.defect: Bridge supports miss the water (floating pier caps) and cables alias.
bridge-low.fix: Extend piers into the water with footings; render cables as thin tubes with MSAA.

bridge-low.defect: Crowns are identical spheres of equal size in a row.
bridge-low.fix: Instance 4+ crown meshes with random scale and yaw.

bridge-low.defect: Cloned identical tree spheres in a row.
Stabilizer plane intersects the fuselage with no fairing and the fin root shows a gap in f015.
bridge-low.fix: Add root fairings and close the fin-fuselage join.
Enable planar reflections near the bridge.

bridge-low.defect: No spray or wake interaction with floats near the surface.
bridge-low.fix: Add float spray/wake particles below 3 m altitude.

cloudy.defect: Worst call count of the round; both budgets exceeded by 30-38%.
cloudy.fix: Batch vegetation and marina props; reduce tree LOD0 tris.
Fix tree albedo/AO and add species.

cloudy.defect: Reflects a blue sky that is not there; overcast grey missing from the water.
Layer is a flat textured plane with a sharp cutout edge at H2 and no vertical structure.
cloudy.fix: Add multi-layer stratocumulus with bottom undulation.

cloudy.defect: Hard cloud shadows on water and sharp tree shading under a full overcast.
Shadows are as hard as under clear sky; no aircraft shadow.

cockpit-city.defect: Still frame at 197% of the triangle budget and 129% of the call budget; slowest view.
cockpit-city.fix: Cut cockpit gauge tessellation and cull the exterior aircraft LOD when in cockpit mode.

cockpit-city.defect: Specular response is absent on all interior surfaces.
cockpit-city.fix: Add specular/roughness maps and an interior environment probe.
Remove the box and close the wing mesh.

cockpit-city.defect: Wing underside and cabin walls are one uniform-roughness lambert colour with no texture.
cockpit-city.fix: Add a fabric/aluminium roughness map and AO to the wing underside and interior.

cockpit-city.defect: Cockpit receives no shadow cascade contribution at all.
cockpit-city.fix: Include the cockpit meshes in cascade 0 with a tight near-cascade fit.
Add clearcoat to gauge faces and a fresnel term to the windscreen.

cockpit-city.defect: Overhead cylinder is a bare primitive and wing-strut intersection has no fillet or bracket.
cockpit-city.fix: Model a magnetic compass housing and strut brackets.

cockpit-city.defect: Uniform roughness across panel, coaming, headliner and yoke.
cockpit-city.fix: Author distinct materials: textured vinyl headliner, brushed panel, rubber yoke grip.

cockpit-city.defect: No fresnel reflection, dirt or refraction on the glass; the glass plane is invisible rather than rendered.
cockpit-city.fix: Add a fresnel-weighted reflection and subtle smudge texture to the windshield.
Enable planar reflections for the bay.

cockpit-city.defect: Wake is a single straight streak with no V or fade.
cockpit-city.fix: Use a V-wake mesh with foam falloff.

cockpit-city.defect: Trees are identical dark-green spheres in a row.
cockpit-city.fix: Vary species, scale and hue per tree.

glass-sun.defect: No fresnel or sun highlight on glass facing the 15:30 sun; reflection smeared.
glass-sun.fix: Fresnel + environment reflection with correct filtering.

glass-sun.defect: Zero throttle aircraft drifts at 3.5 m/s.
glass-sun.fix: Increase water drag at idle in physics.ts.

harbor.defect: No ground shadows from warehouses, containers or the aircraft on the apron.
harbor.fix: Extend cascade coverage and mark props as shadow casters.
Instance containers with a lower-poly mesh.

harbor.defect: Evenly spaced objects and floating geometry.
harbor.fix: Jitter placement and remove the sphere.

harbor.defect: Identical warehouses and evenly spaced identical cubes along them.

harbor.fix: Add crane booms/trolleys, container corrugation, ship bridge.

island-pass.fix: Palm meshes with fronds and trunk.

island-pass.defect: Buildings are flat untextured boxes with no windows, balconies or roof detail at close range.
island-pass.fix: Add facade window textures and parapets for LOD0.

island-pass.defect: Palms are identical dark sprites at even spacing along the shore (f050).
Sea meets sky in a crisp dark-blue line with no haze band.
island-pass.fix: Add horizon fog blending sea into sky over 2 deg.

island-pass.defect: Evenly spaced identical palms; repeated box towers.

island-pass.fix: Add balcony rails and window insets.

island-pass.defect: No roads, lawns or pavement variation.

night.defect: Clouds render daylight white against a dark sky; sky.ts cloud shader uses uSunColor*2.9*0.3 at night, still far above sky luminance.
night.fix: Tint night clouds with the moon colour and clamp lightCol to ~2x the sky radiance when nightMix>0.5.

night.defect: Both budgets exceeded: draw calls +23% and triangles +5% in still and flight.
night.fix: Cull city facade instances behind the camera in culling.ts and lower LOD for the far suburb at night.

night.defect: Clouds lit by a daytime sun.

night.fix: Higher-res planar reflection with wave distortion.

night.defect: Hard light-blue horizon band at A3-H3.
Night exposure is a dimmed daytime scene, not night.
night.fix: Implement a night lighting state: dark sky, moonlight 0.05x, emissive city, no daylight clouds.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Glass shows texture bleed and no fresnel.
plane-front-quarter.fix: Separate glass UV and add fresnel.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Glass is milky grey with a hard horizontal bottom edge and a uniform frost; windshield shows no sky reflection.
plane-front-quarter.fix: Reduce glass opacity to ~0.15 with an environment reflection and fresnel in model.ts.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Zero throttle aircraft accelerates to 3.5 m/s; static prop at idle RPM.
plane-front-quarter.fix: Increase water drag at idle in physics.ts and animate the prop.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Ghost strut through the fuselage and segmented bridge deck.

plane-front-quarter.fix: Fix UV aspect and mip filtering.

plane-front-quarter.defect: Flat bases and stringy fragments in crops/distant.png.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Crowns are faceted polyhedra with near-black navy faces (B2, F2-G2): back-facing normals or missing ambient make half of every tree black.
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Fix crown normals/ambient in vegetation.ts so shaded faces stay dark green, not navy.
Randomize hull, sail state and spacing.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: A moored aircraft with zero throttle accelerates to 3.5 m/s: physics.ts water drag/wind model pushes it.
plane-rear-quarter.fix: Apply mooring or higher water drag at throttle 0 in physics.ts.

plane-rear-quarter.defect: Rear side window is an opaque dark brown rectangle.

skyline-high.defect: Both budgets exceeded in still and flight.
skyline-high.fix: Merge district building instances; cull hinterland props.

skyline-high.defect: Flat terrain plane with visible noise tile and hard horizon seam.
skyline-high.fix: Add inland suburb geometry and blend terrain into haze.

skyline-high.defect: Hinterland is a uniform pale speckled plane with a repeating lattice to a hard straight land/sky edge at row 3.
skyline-high.fix: Add terrain elevation noise, lakes and distance haze; break the lattice with a large-scale mask.

skyline-high.defect: Hinterland is a regular lattice of identical blocks; suburb boxes repeat.
skyline-high.fix: Break the lattice with noise and district variation.

skyline-high.defect: Aircraft exits the frame by flight.png; inland fill at A3-H3 is a flat speckled plane.
skyline-high.fix: Follow camera; add inland terrain detail.

skyline-high.defect: Hard horizon seam between the terrain plane and sky across the full width.

sunset.defect: Glints are large discrete white blobs (confetti) and 9% of glitter pixels toggle per clip frame.
sunset.fix: Use a filtered GGX specular with LEAN/Toksvig roughness for distant water.
Add sun bloom/halo, tie glitter to wave normal and sun vector.

water-landing.fix: V-wake with foam and gradual spawn.

water-landing.defect: Hard, fully opaque shadow on water.
water-landing.fix: PCSS and reduce water shadow opacity.

water-landing.defect: No mirrored aircraft on calm water 2 m below it in still, flight or clip.
water-landing.fix: Add the aircraft layer to the reflection camera and raise fresnel at near-vertical view.

water-landing.defect: Many crowns near-black (A3, G3): foliage shaded as fully unlit at 13:00.
Hard horizon seam with light band.

water-landing.fix: Reduce shadow strength to 50-60% and soften edges.

water-landing.defect: Populated bay shows no structures on the shore.
water-landing.fix: Add shore huts and a marina.
